propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close only in rebar.toml while the reusable schema retains false defaults.
Prove integrated lifecycle behavior through public surfaces without eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation events, new pin commands, list-output changes, or stored relation migrations.
Legacy pre-feature unpinned attestations must continue passing both gates after enablement.
Invalidation should occur only after actual narrow material changes, including natural A-to-B-to-C transitive propagation, while unchanged successful re-reviews produce no further propagation.
depends_on and inbound blocks references to one canonical prerequisite must normalize to a single prerequisite pin/evaluation.

Missing public lifecycle coverage remains for re-review non-propagation, in-progress self-edit invalidation, enable/disable/re-enable, code-only close freshness, return-to-open reset, and deleted/archived pinned targets, keeping the story in progress.
